00.name: Lumberjack
00.text: Phew. That tree was tuff but I got it done. Now time to go home and enjoy that pint.

01.name: Narrator
01.text: A bright light descends from the sky and envelopes the lumberjack.

03.text: Stand ready for our arrival lumberer.

04.text: No need to be afraid, for you are in the presense of lord Pasta's greatest advisors.

05.name: Sweat
05.text: My name is Sweat but my friends call me sweaty.

07.name: Sweat
07.text: Today is your lucky day mortal for in lord Pasta's infinite wisdom he has bestowed upon you a quest.

09.name: Sour
09.text: That's right lumberer a quest of the utmost importance. One that if not completed will leave a dark stain upon lord Pasta.

10.name: Lumberjack
10.text: I mean do I have to. I was planning on heading to the tavern to get a pint. Can't you find someone else to do it.

11.name: Sour
11.text: Your name was specifically mentioned by lord Pasta lumberer. Your compliance is not mandatory, however, your presence is and force will be used as motivation.

12.name: Lumberjack
12.text: I don't have a choice do I?

14.name: Sweat
14.text: Wonderful. Now that you have decided to help us on this most noble quest mortal it is time to tell you how you will be of service.

15.name: Narrator
15.text: A blinding light yet again envelopes the lumberjack but this time when the light fades the lumberjack is left holding a chest in both his arms.

16.name: Sweat
16.text: Within this chest lies a powerful relic. It is your responsibility to travel north into the mountains of Penne, domain of lord Pasta and deliver it to him.

17.name: Lumberjack
17.text: Is that it. Doesn't seem to hard.

18.name: Sweat
18.text: But alas it is not. For lord Pasta has many jealous rivals.

20.name: Sweat
20.text: And they all seak to smear his name. By getting their hands on the relic.

21.name: Lumberjack
21.text: So. All I have to do is take this chest, deliver it to lord Pasta and that's it.

22.name: Sour
22.text: That is correct lumberer. But fret not for you will be acompanied by me and sweaty over there to help you in your journey.

23.name: Sweat
23.text: And I have no dought that lord Pasta will greatly reward you for completing your quest.

24.name: Lumberjack
24.text: Reward! You should have started with that. Let's hit the road.
